summary: 1. Total production +5.17% vs target, waste -5.32%. 2. MTD narrows to -7.4% (from -7.84%); MTD ore widens to +7.93%. 3. EX-262 recovers same day, after roughly 3.5 days down (cylinder change out and hydraulic system, since 08-Sep). 4. Overall fleet daily availability climbs to 85.31% (MTD 86.04%), Core Fleet Daily 78.66%. 5. Dump Trucks post 95.95% daily availability, +10.95 points over MTD. 6. Survey Day 18 (Sep 12, in progress) flips to the first positive daily gap since Sep 4: trucks 12,090 / survey 16,020, gap +3,930 BCM (+24.53%) — survey reads above the truck tally for the first time in two weeks. 7. MTD survey-vs-truck gap narrows to -48,509 BCM (-16.03%) from -18.3% at the 116th pass. 8. Abel Eben Pienaar (Maaden/JRAR leadership) escalates the survey gap directly to Peter, calling the figures "NOT acceptable," asking that the dispatch-admin capture go live 12-Sep, and that load counts be physically checked. 9. The weekly operational review deck (week ending 11-Sep) surfaces a 33,047 BCM broken-stock reconciliation gap between the client-report figure (164,371 BCM) and the deck's own survey-based Stage 4D/5 split (197,418 BCM), which the deck itself flags for reconciliation before a rehandle plan. Six standing open questions resolve or partially resolve via the Task Feedback Log (Part C), none of them mismatches: the Sep 7 10.5-hour crusher "Maintenance" stop was planned; the Day 14+ survey gap's loading-location/overspill cause is confirmed (not a residual reporting-integrity effect); the 870-B501 grade control "9,945 BCM" figure is a units error (should read tons); the Stage 4 ramp's 16% gradient issue is closed by taking the ramp out of service rather than regrading it (Stage 4-vs-Stage 5 naming ambiguity stays open); LT-200's long-standing-down status is closed by instruction to stop chasing it, not by a confirmed root cause; the external-survey-audit SOW has moved to supplier bidding (discipline choice not restated). Two rows confirmed already-Done tasks with no KB-relevant open question (a personal SGR-refund follow-up, out of scope; a DT-operator leave-papers task, which surfaces the new HR RAW file below). New HR file: `RAW/HR/DT Leave Overlap Tracker.xlsx` — October dump-truck operator arrivals/departures, net-balanced (9 in, 9 out) but with two dates showing departures with no confirmed same-day arrival (20-Oct, 26-Oct). Cross-referenced against the same-day Task Feedback Log reply committing to staggered departures. Written verbatim to `RAW/Meeting Notes/`, footnote source-anchors stripped per convention, registered in `_INGESTED.md`. Important References folder re-checked: 37 files, no new content since the 104th-116th passes' last check. CIP folder re-checked: 8 files, no new content since the 116th pass. Part C (Task Feedback Log): 8 unprocessed rows (all Status blank, all logged 2026-09-12 — the known blank-Status gap, not the "New" view). No task/feedback mismatches. No content removed or renamed from RAW. ---
